metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_directional_alig: Mean pairwise cosine of fixed-seed sampled real-item embeddings, mapped to [0,1]. Measures directional alignment, not conclusive collapse or recommendation diversity. Null means unavailable.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:representation_geometry: Separate fixed-seed real-item and appended-MASK user samples. Reports raw mean L2 norm, mean squared centered coordinates, and singular values of the centered representation matrix. RankMe = exp(-sum(p*log(p))), p=sigma/sum(sigma); zero spectra and fewer than two samples yield unavailable rank/statistics. User readout uses the maximum nonpadding index.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:training_branch_allocation: Selected-checkpoint training measurements. Saved allocation={}; objective=0.5*reconstruction_sum/Nr + 0.5*terminal_sum/Nt; reconstruction=latest maxlen events; 0.15 MASK-only with one-target fallback; terminal_context=strict prefix of at most maxlen-1 events plus MASK; cutoff_probabilities={"n_eq_2_endpoint": 1.0, "n_gt_2_endpoint": 0.1, "nonterminal": "0.9/(n-2)"}; empty_branch_policy=None. Epoch and cumulative intervals are explicit. Batch records contain detached summed CE, exact target denominators, applied branch and per-target coefficients, coefficient masses and objective contributions. Aggregate CE per target differs from mean batch objective. Allocation and coefficient mass are neither loss-value nor gradient shares. Diagnostic-loader coverage cannot recover training allocation. No improved HR@10, variance optimality or paired baseline result is inferred.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:training_allocation_consis: Checks on saved example totals and active-branch coefficient masses. Empty list means these checks found no disagreement; null means the training snapshot is unavailable. Missing records are explicit. These checks do not verify an independent baseline source identity.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Counts low-margin and wrong-rank supervised real-item positions. Category breakdowns are unavailable because item categories are not supplied. Observed input counts distinguish MASK, different real item and same real item, but cannot identify exact stochastic corruption branches without matched sampler bookkeeping. Empty batch counts measure probe coverage; empty margin metrics are null. The legacy supervised_positions and observed-input counters require both a valid positive and a valid negative. valid_target_positions counts real positive labels at nonpadding inputs independently of negative availability. terminal_position_targets counts those labels at each sequence's maximum nonpadding index. Terminal-position coverage divides that count by presented_sequences; it is null when no sequences were measured. These diagnostic-loader counts do not establish the training branch allocation: both reconstruction and terminal examples can supervise their final position. These training probes are not host validation HR@10.
